project.description: A3 linearizability + fault-injection harness (R-04). Drives a REAL separate-JVM Configd cluster (the shaded configd-server jar) over the REAL TcpRaftTransport, under OS-level faults (iptables / tc / kill -9), records a checker-neutral op-history, and verifies it with a TRUSTED third-party checker (Porcupine). This deliberately does NOT use the in-process SimulatedNetwork — that is the path that hid R-01. The harness treats the server as a black box (HTTP + process control), so it depends on no other io.configd module at compile time.
